node.title: XR SL-2-RES maximal selected window-divisor count: exact-depth residual <=17n^2/25
node.statement: At each prize row and high band-proper depth, let R_d(u,v) contain the degree-(n-k-d) monic split squarefree divisors E_T|X^n-1 satisfying both top-d window systems, whose reconstructed codeword pair has full joint core exactly H\T, has L_P>=2 under support-wise first-match selection, and survives the generic strip order. Then 25|R_d|<=17n^2. The exact remaining alternatives are the full-joint-rank split-divisor target and, at deficient rank, the active-defect-local target whose every selected off-core block lies in the support D of the invariant primitive residual. The complementary deficient family is proved to have size at most n-|D| and the red leaf receives the exact remaining budget. Raw affine divisors without maximality/selection remain outside the assertion.
